title: Capacity constraints — a matrix is just a list of rules

checkpoints.hint: Slide the rack capacity and budget and watch the intersection — the one valid CPU/GPU config — slide with them. That intersection is the 'solution' to the system; the matrix on the right is just those constraints with the variable names stripped out. Then flip 'conflicting constraints' on: the lines go parallel, never cross, and the matrix goes singular — two rules that can't both hold, so there's no valid deployment at all.
